digest.component_or_area: Configuration ownership and legacy facade removal (RP-04 S7)
propositions: Direct ambient config/credential reads and backend property reloads must be rejected below centralized composition seams via a deterministic AST ownership gate with explicit registry of approved roots.
Every new configuration or credential name must map to exactly one owner; legacy migration exceptions must be exact and shrink-only, empty before contract-phase closure.
The ownership gate must integrate into `make lint` and CI such that parity tests fail if either ownership or field-consumption direction invocation is omitted.

Generated configuration, security, and operator documentation must be byte-current with schema and ownership registries, covering lifecycle, precedence, restart, observability, subprocess, and behavior-delta topics.
Legacy facades, migration switches, and exception entries are removed only after focused suites, bounded provider/op-cert/reconciler canaries pass with redacted evidence and no credential leakage.
